4 احرب الحَرْبَ He excited, provoked, or stirred up, war. (K.) ―
-b2- احربهُ He guided him to spoil, or plunder; guided him, or showed him the way, to obtain spoil, or plunder, of an enemy; (S, K, TA;) acting as a spy. (TA.) ―
-b3- He found him to be despoiled, or plundered, of his wealth, or property, or of all his wealth, or property. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
